svg.title: Mines' Mapper art sheet: edit this one file, each picture has its own box
svg.desc: Each picture is a nested svg with data-file="folder/name.svg" and the viewBox of its file. Do not move the boxes: keep the data-file attribute. Keep the viewBox of each box.
svg.text: Draw inside each dotted box. Each box is one picture: keep its data-file attribute. Light grey box = the picture, dotted = keep the drawing inside it.
SINGLE COLOUR: the chart pictures on island maps
The game paints each one in ONE ink colour (shape only). Use one colour, solid fills or thick lines. Keep it inside the dotted margin.
KEEP YOUR COLOURS: map glyphs (flags, mines, power-ups)
Several colours are fine. Use a dark outline so they read on parchment, the dark paper and the icy theme. Keep them centred and bold.
KEEP YOUR COLOURS: interface icons (48 x 48 units)
Several colours are fine. Thick, simple strokes: shown at 16-32 px next to text.
KEEP YOUR COLOURS: menu creatures (eagle flap frames and UFO)
Draw the eagle from above flying RIGHT; the UFO level, seen from the side. Wide 128 x 64 pictures.
